_comment: Per-project file. init_project.py does NOT overwrite this file if it already exists.
name: Viwenta

verify._comment: Empty = the AI must ask the user how to verify. Each command must exit 0 on pass. A slow command / one that concerns only part of the repo: write it as {"cmd": "...", "paths": ["tools/asset_check/", "*.blend"]} -> the Stop hook demands it only when a changed file matches paths (a folder ends with /, or a glob).

checklist: Every new or changed C# script compiles with no errors in the Unity Console
Every changed scene or prefab opens with no missing-reference or missing-script warnings
Every new .cs, scene, prefab, texture or material has its .meta file committed
No file under Library/, Logs/, UserSettings/ or Temp/ is committed
New assets live under Assets/_Project/ in the matching subfolder
_checklist: Verification criteria that are NOT run as commands (for planning, ideas, documents... projects, or as a supplement to code). The AI checks each item and records pass/fail in '## Kiểm chứng'. Written in English (AGENTS.md §11.1). E.g.: "Every work item has an owner and a deadline".

format_on_edit._comment: Command run after each AI file edit. {file} is replaced by the file path. Leave empty to disable.

router._comment: Tune skill suggestions for this project. ignore_keywords: keywords not used for suggestions (written without diacritics, e.g. "skill" if the game has character skills). disable_skills: names of skills that are never suggested (e.g. code skills when the project has no code yet).

_model_roles: Role follows the running model (AGENTS.md §10): a model name containing a word from planner → Planner (design, write briefs, review); executor → Executor (follows briefs in .ai/briefs/).
_child_sessions: Claude Code desktop (AGENTS.md §10.7). auto_chain = true: the review after exec finishes and the re-exec after 'changes needed' are handed to a child session right away, reusing a child session of the same level (clear + send the command). false: shows a proposal card for the user to click (each click opens a new session).
_context: Context warnings by real tokens (read from the transcript). context_warn_tokens: long context, suggests /clear when switching tasks. context_handoff_tokens: above this threshold, finish the current step then handoff + /clear even on the same task (every turn re-reads the whole context, so long sessions cost a lot of usage; 0 = off). context_window_tokens: the model's context window (e.g. 200000 or 1000000; 0 = unknown) -> strong warning at >= 85% used, auto-compact is near.
